curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Lay out the four GDL steps, then the learner permit's age, holding period, supervisor and curfew.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards on each GDL step and the learner permit limits.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Questions on the GDL steps and learner permit rules.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Trace the move from Intermediate Restricted to Intermediate Unrestricted to the regular license.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards on intermediate requirements, fees, card markings and the regular license.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Questions on when and how a teen moves up each level.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Contrast the passenger limit and the two curfews, then the seat belt and work zone rules.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards on passenger exceptions, curfews, seat belts and work zones.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Scenario questions on passengers, curfews and work zones.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain how points, crashes, forged letters and phone violations slow or reverse GDL progress.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards on each penalty and the phone and texting bans.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Questions on GDL penalties and phone rules.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Show where a teen arriving with an out-of-state permit or license enters the Tennessee GDL.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards on each new-resident teen scenario.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Scenario questions on teens arriving from other states.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover who signs the teen affidavit, then which school proofs are accepted and the dropout rules.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards on affidavit signers and each school proof.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Questions on affidavits, school proof and dropout consequences.
